aspects.highConcept: Bookworm middle child of the noble Bansz family
aspects.trouble: Sleepy- will nap and wrap up in blankets at any chance
other: Feverish- feels cold all the time. Frail

stunts.name: Wikipedia
stunts.description: Palava can use an arcane eldritch knowledge book to look up information on nearly any topic in the world. It gains access to any mundane and unprotected books passively and these can be looked up if the name or general topic is known. For rare and complicated bits of knowledge or those in protected tomes- roll lore against difficulty set by DM.

stunts.name: Magic User
stunts.description: Palava can learn and cast spells with incantations - their secrets often appear in her eldritch knowledge book. Learn Dancing Lights and any 2 other harmless cantrips in the style of DnD. Magic is cast using Lore

stunts.name: Magical Fluency
stunts.description: Learn four cantrips and three 1st level spells in the style of DnD
